answers.text: 'Weekly trend is up and at its highs.' A weekly HH/HL is trend, not a sound base. My R3 test reads structure 53.7 as weak, and D still prints swing LH/LL. A rising tide with no measurable base gives me no pivot to buy from. The W 2.0% past the swing high does not repair the base.

'Weekly tide is up; elder_5d shows permission.' elder_5d is not my field and an impulse permission is not a base. R3 still fails: structure 53.7, and D shows swing LH/LL. With no sound base there is no pivot and nothing downstream rescues it (C12, C14).

'Volume floor and div are not my test.' They are mine. C16: under +40% volume is a hard rejection, and day_vol 1.18 misses the 1.40 line. W 9.7% and D 5.7% above the last swing high is a late entry on a breakout nobody bought, and H1 sits below EMA9.

'Late past the swing high is not a fault.' In my method it is (C17): D 5.7% past the swing high is a late-buy warning. And the volume test is mine, not a proxy: day_vol 1.18 is under 1.40, a C16 hard reject. W/D HH/HL shows trend, not a confirmed breakout.

'Light day_vol 0.85 is a proxy I do not read.' I read it, and it is my C16 test: day_vol 0.85 is far under 1.40, so the D break 1.6% above the swing high was not bought. H1 prints LH/LL below EMA9. A group peer breaking with it does not supply the volume.

'D HH/HL 1.6% above the swing high is a fresh break.' Agreed, it is fresh and inside 5% of the pivot (C17). But a fresh break needs +40% volume to count (C16): day_vol 0.85 fails it. H1 LH/LL below EMA9 shows no follow-through either.

'Extension is a weight, not a veto.' Not for me: past 10% from the pivot is a hard rejection (C17), and D is 15.7% above the last swing high. day_vol 0.81 fails C16 on top. A fast move past a cleared pivot is a name to hold, not one to buy now.

'Established uptrend in a reaction; I buy the new high.' So do I, but on volume. D 3.7% above the swing high came on day_vol 1.02, under 1.40 (C16). H1 closed at 14% of the day's range below EMA9: a close near the low is a C25 caution, not demand.

'A retracement does not need volume.' A retracement does not; my buy does. I buy a pivot breakout on +40% volume (C16), and day_vol 1.02 is not that. H1 at 14% of the day's range below EMA9 is the pullback you describe: no buy point in my method until a volume break.

'A light-volume pullback is a normal reaction.' Light volume in a pullback is not distribution, I grant that. But it is not a buy either: D sits 3.2% above the swing high with day_vol 0.84, and H1 prints LH/LL below EMA9. My buy needs a 1.40 volume break (C16).

'day_vol 0.84 on a pullback is the preferred back-up.' My dry-up rule (C15) is for the base lows and the handle, before the break. Here D is already 3.2% past the swing high. The breakout must show +40% volume (C16), and nothing I can see shows it.

'Leader fails my C23 test: mid-pack rank.' My L substitute is rs_leadership, which reads LEADER (downday 2.0). Group rank inside Utilities is not served, so C9 is a declared gap, not a fail. day_vol 1.83 clears 1.40 and D 3.4% above the swing high is inside 5% (C17).

'Uptrend in a normal reaction; buy only the new high.' We agree on the new high; I add the volume. day_vol 1.08 is under 1.40, so the D 4.8% advance past the swing high is unconfirmed (C16). structure 66.3 is middling. A peer in the group does not supply volume.

'day_vol 1.01 is not my test.' It is mine. KO has the best base shape in its group, D 0.3% above the swing high and inside 5% (C17), but the break came on day_vol 1.01. Under 1.40 is a C16 hard rejection. A group peer breaking with it is not breakout volume.

'day_vol 1.01 meets my genuine-break floor of 1.0.' My floor is 1.40, not 1.0 (C16). Your own trigger still wants 1.2x, so we agree the break is not yet bought. D 0.3% above the swing high is the right spot; the volume is missing.

'A test of the prior swing high needs no surge.' A test does not; a breakout does. D is 1.2% above the swing high, so it is past the pivot, and day_vol 1.02 is under 1.40 (C16). W last bar red. In my method this break was not bought.

'Light volume is the pullback drying up.' Dry-up belongs in the base and handle (C15), before the break. CHD is already 0.4% past the swing high on day_vol 0.87, under 1.40 (C16). H1 is below EMA9 with 9<21: no strength in the hour either.
